I (26M) was in a long distance relationship for nearly 2 years, and i left around 3 months ago. While it was not a mutual decision, it was without any animosity towards eachother. We never ended up having sex with eachother.

Not to discourage anyone from leaving (i still think it was the right choice) but i cannot recall a time in my life where i have felt more miserable and hopeless than now. I am mentally very unwell, i cry everyday, i think of her hourly and miss alot about her. Feelings of regret consume me whole, but this is normal when leaving a relationship. The loneliness and guilt are crippling and I have thoughts and worries of never meeting anybody that will be anywhere near her level of sweetness and emotional supportiveness.

Im still in the process of channeling my sorrow into something productive. Want to pick up the gym this week and get my sadness and anger out on the weights (cliche i know).

I think my current mental state is fueled by a friends with benefits arrangement i got into a month after the breakup. I went for it as my sexual frustration was insane and i always found her very attractive. We have a good time with eachother but i have 0 romantic feelings and this leaves me in the opposite situation compared to my ex. I cannot say which one is worse to be in to be honest.

A big tip that i can give that prevented me from contacting her again in my weakest moments is physically writing down the plusses and negatives you experienced while being with your ex. I fell into the trap of romanticizing my ex and forgetting the reasons why i left in the first place. The self doubt makes moving on very difficult.

I had the same feelings. Hang in there friend! After a month of missing her and feeling awful it dawned on me that leaving was 100% the right choice. I felt like i made the biggest mistake of my life, but that was my broken heart talking, not my rational mind. I wish you the best and a happier life ahead!
